newsitem.title: JAPAN: DLR STEADY VS YEN, IMPACT FROM C/A DATA LIMITED.
newsitem.headline: DLR STEADY VS YEN, IMPACT FROM C/A DATA LIMITED.

text.p: 0006 GMT --*Dollar moving narrowly against yen after Japan's June current account surplus came out at top end of market expectations.
*Surplus in Japan's current account rose 55.8 percent in June from a year earlier to 1.02 trillion yen.
*Economists' forecasts for data ranged from 840 billion yen to 1.1 trillion yen.
*"Impact from the data was limited because it was within market expectatations, but I think selling pressures will emerge near 118.70 yen," a city bank dealer said.
